operation: GET /hardware/{id}/checkout as the lab technician (opens the checkout form)
rationale: The form is read-mostly and is the first screen of every loan. A technician at a desk should see it within about one second. Limits are set for the one-machine, four-PHP-worker local setup used in the lab; they are not production targets.
unexpectedFailure: Any response that is not HTTP 200, that lands on the login page, or that lacks the checkout form for the fixture laptop.
